name: Googie
description: Roadside-sign kites from the space age: tall diamonds crossed by a bar with a ball at each end, tilted every which way.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --t: translate(@r(-10%, 10%), @r(-8%, 8%)) rotate(@r(-35deg, 35deg)) scale(@r(.8, 1.05)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--kite); clip-path: @var(--kite); transform: @var(--t); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @var(--bar); mask: @var(--bar); transform: @var(--t); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --kite: polygon(50% 1%, 62% 36%, 50% 99%, 38% 36%); --bar: linear-gradient(#000, #000) 50% 35.57% / 70% 3% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 99%, transparent 100%) 9.77% 33.91% / 13% 13% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 99%, transparent 100%) 90.23% 33.91% / 13% 13% no-repeat; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
